title: johnsonia lupulina var. teretifolia
intro: Johnsonia lupulina var. teretifolia, commonly known as the 'Terete-leaved Johnsonia', is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Asphodelaceae. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Therapeutically, Johnsonia lupulina var. teretifolia has been reported to have actions such as anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antiseptic properties, which can be attributed to its ability to relax bronchial muscles and promote the expulsion of mucus. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
